LoginError.text: Something went wrong while logging in. Please try again.

CommandPalette.title: Command palette
CommandPalette.description: Jump to a page or start an action

Home.title: Membership
Home.intro: Here you see your membership, pay the membership fee and, if you are on the board, handle the members.
Home.mustBeLoggedIn: Log in or create an account to use Membership. FGV's memberships and user accounts are here.
Home.membershipText: See your memberships and pay the membership fee.
Home.treasurerText: Payments, bank statements and transactions to match.
Home.adminText: Users and their access, fees and settings.

Register.title: Create account
Register.intro: You will get an email with a link where you confirm your address and choose a password. After that an administrator gives you access to FGV's applications.
Register.messageHint: Who are you and what do you want access to?
Register.sent: If the address can be used, we have sent a message with a link. The link is valid for 48 hours.

error.challenge: The check that you are not a robot failed. Please try again.
error.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
error.invalid: Check the details and try again.
error.unavailable: The account could not be created right now. Please try again later.

Verify.title: Confirm email address
Verify.explain: Confirm your email address. You will then get a message where you choose a password.
Verify.done: Thank you! Your address is confirmed. You will now get a message where you choose a password. After that an administrator gives you access, and you get a message when it is done.
Verify.invalid: The link no longer works. Create the account again if it has expired.

Users.name: Name
Users.applicationsHelp: Pick the highest role. The roles below it are given too, and the roles above it are removed.
Users.inconsistent: The roles in Keycloak do not follow the ladder. Save to repair them.
Users.notify: Send an email to the user about this update
Users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate the account and log the user out?
Users.sendSetPassword: Send link to choose a password
Users.sendPasswordReset: Send link to reset the password
Users.title: Users

Membership.title: My membership
Membership.notLinked: Your account is not linked to a spexare in the register yet, so there is no membership to show. Contact the board.
Membership.applicationPending: Your application has been sent. The board will answer by email.
Membership.applicationRejected: Your earlier application was not accepted
Membership.applyIntro: Tell us who you are and how you have been part of the spex. The board links your account to the register and lets you know.
Membership.applyText: How have you been part of the spex?

Pay.title: Pay a membership fee
Pay.intro: Pick the fee for each year you want to pay for, or the one-time fee for a life membership.
Pay.noFees: No fees are open for payment right now.
Pay.keepReference: Keep the reference unchanged in the message. It is how the treasurer finds your payment.
Pay.paidBy: Who paid, if it was someone else
Pay.reported: Thank you! We will confirm when the treasurer has found your payment.
Pay.waitingForConfirmation: Waiting for confirmation: you have said that you paid. You get an email when the treasurer has found the payment.
Pay.confirmed: Your payment is confirmed. Thank you!
Pay.familyNote: Who is in the family? (names, so that the board can give them the membership)
Pay.familyHint: E.g. my partner Gösta and our children Lisa and Pelle
Pay.familyPending: A family membership: the board will add the family members you named.

Treasurer.title: Payments
Treasurer.intro: Requests that wait for payment. Record a payment when you have seen the money, in the bank or in Swish; the payer gets a receipt and the membership counts.

status.REPORTED: The payer says they have paid

Treasurer.confirmCancel: Cancel this request and its memberships?
Treasurer.undoIntro: A payment can be undone until the year ends.
Treasurer.confirmUndo: Undo this payment? The request is open again.
Treasurer.exportPayments: The year's payments for the bookkeeping (Excel)

Fees.title: Fees
Fees.intro: What a membership costs for a year, or the one-time fee for a life membership. Retired fees are not offered to members but stay on what was paid.

Defaults.title: Default access
Defaults.intro: The access a new account gets when it is created from a payment made elsewhere, e.g. in an external shop. The kind of membership paid decides which set it gets. The highest role you pick on an application comes with the roles below it. Existing accounts are never changed.

profileHints.MEMBER: Everything members use, except what is left out here.
profileHints.SUPPORT: A support membership gives less: by default User on Spexipedia, Spexflix, Spexgram and Spexify.

Bank.importIntro: Upload the account's transactions as a CSV file from the bank. Only incoming transactions are kept, and the same transaction is never imported twice, so overlapping files are fine. Importing is optional: payments can always be recorded by hand.
Bank.noFormats: No bank format is described yet. An administrator describes the bank's file under Bank formats.
Bank.matchedAtOnce: Matched at once by their reference
Bank.errors: The file could not be read, nothing was imported:
Bank.transactionsIntro: Incoming transactions that nothing has been matched to. Tick the request or requests the money was for (two members may have paid together), or dismiss a transaction that is not a membership payment.
Bank.noTransactions: No transactions wait for a match.
Bank.confirmDismiss: Dismiss this transaction? Its text and payer are deleted.
Bank.reportedWithoutMatch: Reported payments waiting to be found, oldest first

Formats.title: Bank formats
Formats.intro: Describe each bank's CSV once: which columns hold the date, the amount, the text and the payer (counted from 1), how dates are written and what the file's character set is. A change of bank is a new format.
Formats.name: Name
Formats.saved: The bank format has been saved.
Formats.deleted: The bank format has been deleted.

Member.waiver: Grant a membership without a fee
Member.waiverIntro: For an honorary member, say. Pick the year, or life from that year, and say why.
Member.sendLinkIntro: Tick what to pay for. The member gets an email with a personal link to the payment page.
Member.notSent: The request was made but no email could be sent (no address?).
Member.record: Record a payment without a request
Member.recordIntro: For someone who paid without asking first: tick what it was for; the request is made and marked paid.

Renewals.title: Renewal reminders
Renewals.intro: Last year's members who have nothing for the year yet, are not members for life and have not asked to be left alone get an email with a payment request and a personal link.
Renewals.noFee: There is no fee for {year} yet. An administrator adds it under Fees.
Renewals.recipients: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody would get a reminder} one {# person would get a reminder} other {# people would get a reminder}}
Renewals.confirm: Send {count, plural, one {# reminder} other {# reminders}}?
Renewals.done: Sent: {sent}. Left out (no email address, or it failed): {skipped}.

Personal.optedOut: You will not be reminded again.

Family.title: Family: {reference}
Family.added: The family members have been added.

Applications.title: Applications for membership
Applications.intro: Pick the spexare in Spexregister that the applicant is, or accept without picking one to create a new spexare from the account's name and email address. The applicant is told by email.
Applications.createNew: Create a new spexare from the account

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.intro: Where members pay and who is told about payments. An empty value falls back to what the installation is configured with.
Settings.bank: Bank account for direct transfers (may be left empty)
Settings.days: Remind payers of open requests after (days)
Settings.recipients: Emailed about payments and new registrations
Settings.bankgiro: Bankgiro (pay with the reference as the message)

Maintenance.title: Maintenance
Maintenance.intro: Jobs that run by themselves on a schedule. Run one now if you need to.

Audit.title: Audit log
Audit.intro: Who changed what, newest first, including changes to users' access.
Audit.subject: About

NoAccess.title: You do not have access
NoAccess.text: Your FGV account ({email}) does not have access to Membership. Ask an administrator for access, or log out and log in with another account.

Forbidden.title: You do not have permission
Forbidden.text: You do not have permission to see this page. Ask an administrator if you need it.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.text: The page does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

Errors.CONFLICT: Someone else has changed this. Reload and try again.
Errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do that.
Errors.NOT_FOUND: What you are looking for does not exist.
Errors.SPEXREGISTER_UNAVAILABLE: Spexregister is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
Errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Errors.DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE: The FGV accounts cannot be reached at the moment. Try again in a moment.

About.title: About
About.heading: About Membership
About.description: Membership is provided by FGV for memberships and membership fees, and for user accounts in FGV's applications.
About.feedbackDescription: We value your opinion. Do you have suggestions for improvements or have you found a bug? Get in touch at {email}.

Support.title: Support
Support.heading: How can we help?
Support.description: Have you found a technical fault, or are you having trouble logging in or paying the membership fee? We are happy to help you sort it out.
Support.contactDescription: Describe your problem as clearly as possible. Get in touch at {email}.

Validation.columnInvalid: Enter a whole number; columns are counted from 1.
Validation.daysInvalid: Enter a number of days between 1 and 60.
